The daemon's keyset (created_at, id) never changes for an ended session, so the cursor stays valid. Every row on screen is read again, so each says what is true now. Reads run one after the other in a promise queue (a re-read and Show older never cross; one waiting re-read covers the others). A generation counter drops answers for a project left.
